label: Nokia G-010S-B GPON SFP ONU
description: GPON ONU built into an SFP module (SourcePhotonics ODM, Lantiq PEB98035, OpenWRT) with a 2.5G HSGMII host interface to the router's SFP/SFP+ cage; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/UPC, no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or SSH.
